angle: Unlike other L15 training materials that derive gradients or train networks, this one motivates stochastic updates purely through a cost-scaling story that shrinks a full-batch step to one-sample and mini-batch steps on a tiny line-fitting recap.
angle_detail: Start with [04:21]–[07:18] because the single-sample mechanism and the learning-rate schedule caution carry the core idea. Then watch [07:18]–[08:34] for mini-batches as the stable middle ground with estimates closer to the least-squares reference. Note the assumed prerequisite: all derivatives arrive pre-made from the earlier gradient-descent video, so do not expect backpropagation here, and treat the redundancy-cluster asides as illustration.
